## Summary

I resolved ticket T-2003 by identifying that the catalog-search pods are in a crash loop due to an undersized liveness probe delay. The pods need 50+ seconds to load their index shards before becoming ready, but the current liveness probe configuration with a 30-second delay and only 3 failure attempts kills the container during startup. The fix is to add a Kubernetes startup probe with sufficient failureThreshold to allow the initialization to complete before the liveness probe takes over.
